title: Mary K. Sturdivant as Lockheed insider who helped kill Kona Blue

tellings.quote: there may have been a conflict of interest within Loheed Martin maybe an insider in Loheed who helped put the kibos on the program

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb suggests on Jesse Michels's podcast that a proposed government UFO programme called Kona Blue may have been stopped because of a conflict of interest inside Lockheed Martin, a large American defence contractor. He names a woman called Mary K. Sturdivant as possibly the Lockheed insider who helped shut it down, and also mentions Chris Mellon. If true, it would mean a private company helped decide the fate of a government programme.
